title: GA4GH Beacon / Phenopackets discovery profile (aggregate, no record exposure)
context: Ewing Registry Standards produces an OPEN, CONSENT-FIRST registry STANDARD (common data elements, governance, interoperability profiles) for Ewing Sarcoma. It is NOT a data store and Hee-Lee Oss never holds patient data. Backlog (unscheduled): a GA4GH Beacon / Phenopackets discovery profile that is aggregate-only and exposes no individual records, reinforcing the no-data-store stance. No partner or expert reviewers are secured yet, so verifiedNeed is false and requestor is TO BE SECURED.
objective: Define an aggregate-only GA4GH Beacon / Phenopackets discovery profile that exposes no individual records.
